_notice: Fictional policies for the chatbot to explain.

policies.text: Test drives are free, last up to 30 minutes and must be booked with a sales advisor. A valid driving licence is required.
New vehicles include a 3-year / 60,000-mile manufacturer warranty. Electric batteries are covered for 8 years / 100,000 miles.
Used vehicles include a 12-month warranty. See OFF-004 for the optional upgrade.
Customers may return a vehicle within 14 days or 500 miles for an exchange or refund, subject to inspection. Refunds are only issued by the finance team, never by the chatbot.
A vehicle can only be reserved by a human sales advisor with a refundable GBP 200 deposit
Part-exchange values are given only after an in-person inspection by a sales advisor
Delivery dates are confirmed by a sales advisor after order.
Finance is subject to status and credit checks by a fictional lender.
The chatbot collects only a name, contact preference and vehicle of interest. It does not take payment details, ID documents or sensitive personal data.
